headline.title: 5 ways Google Search can level up your thrift and vintage shopping
headline.summary: The article outlines five strategies for using Google Search to enhance thrift and vintage shopping experiences. It provides tips on optimizing search queries, utilizing image search, and leveraging local listings to find unique items.

articles.title: Dashlane issues opaque advisory warning 20 encrypted vaults were stolen
articles.summary: Dashlane has issued a security advisory indicating that 20 encrypted vaults were stolen, but it has not provided specific details regarding the incident. The company has not commented further on the matter, leaving users with limited information about the breach.

articles.title: Alphabet’s record-breaking $85B raise for Google’s AI business is a helluva good signal
articles.summary: Alphabet has raised a record $85 billion through a stock sale to bolster Google’s AI business, indicating strong investor interest in AI-related ventures. This significant funding could enhance Google's capabilities and competitiveness in the AI sector.

articles.title: Introducing new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind
articles.summary: GPT-Rosalind has been updated to include improved biological reasoning, medicinal chemistry expertise, genomics analysis, and enhanced experimental workflow capabilities, aimed at advancing life sciences research. These new features are designed to facilitate more effective research and analysis in the field.

articles.title: The Humanoid Robot of the Future Is a 6-Foot-Tall Beefcake With a Chinese Body and an American Brain
articles.summary: Nvidia's robotics lead, Spencer Huang, discusses a new humanoid robot that features a robust 6-foot-tall design with a Chinese body and an American brain. This innovative combination aims to leverage strengths from both regions in robotics development.

articles.title: Google’s Dreambeans, its weirdest-named AI tool to date, will turn your life into a cartoon
articles.summary: Google has introduced Dreambeans, an AI tool that creates cartoon-like stories based on users' personal data from their Google accounts. This feature aims to provide a unique and personalized storytelling experience through AI-generated illustrations.

articles.title: As AI gets better, it reveals an empty promise
articles.summary: Google's new Gemini AI agent, Spark, has demonstrated advanced capabilities by accurately recalling personal details about users, raising concerns about privacy and data security. Despite its impressive performance, the article suggests that such advancements may highlight the limitations and ethical implications of AI technology.

articles.title: Amazon’s search bar will invent AI-generated products you can’t buy
articles.summary: Amazon has introduced an updated search bar feature that generates AI-created images of clothing and home goods based on user descriptions. Currently, this feature allows users to select images that match their preferences, facilitating a search for similar items, though the products depicted are not available for purchase.

articles.title: Coralogix raises $200M on bet that someone needs to watch the AI agents
articles.summary: Coralogix has raised $200 million to develop tools aimed at monitoring AI systems as they transition into production. The funding reflects a growing demand for infrastructure solutions that can troubleshoot failures and ensure the reliable operation of AI agents.

articles.title: Publishers will be able to opt out of AI Search, thanks to new regulation
articles.summary: U.K. regulators are mandating that Google provide a tool for website publishers to opt out of generative AI search features. This option will first be tested in the U.K. before being implemented globally.

articles.title: Microsoft and OpenAI broke up — now they’re ready to fight
articles.summary: At its annual Build conference, Microsoft unveiled a range of new AI initiatives, including a super app, in-house reasoning models, and a cybersecurity tool. This announcement signals Microsoft's intent to strengthen its position as a major player in the AI landscape, following its recent split with OpenAI.

articles.title: Meta’s AI agent for WhatsApp Business is now available globally
articles.summary: Meta has launched its AI agent for WhatsApp Business globally, allowing businesses to automate customer interactions. The service will operate on a pay-per-use model, charging businesses based on token usage.
